title: Reading: Installing Postgres and a SQL client

objectives.text: Identify the parts of a PostgreSQL setup: the database server, a database inside it, and a client such as psql that connects to it
Connect to a local database with psql and confirm the server version with SELECT version();
Use the psql meta-commands \l, \dt, \d and \q to list databases, list tables, describe a table and quit
